record.question: Who was the inventor of Telephone?
record.explanation: Smithsonian's object history records Bell's 7 March 1876 telephone patent and 10 March successful transmission with Watson. Bell is the uniquely defensible conventional choice, without asserting that the technology had no other contributors. Historical exam context: 2018 (year only; no day/month printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.si.edu/collections/snapshot/alexander-graham-bells-large-box-telephone Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
